\section{Approach }

Our approach focused on three key areas:
\begin{itemize}
\item Access Control Definition
\item Parameter of Organizational Culture
\item Sustainable Document
\end{itemize}
Based on definition of organizational Culture in chapter 2, we can
get several parameter to analyze the organizational culture, there
are:

\begin{center}
$OrganizationalCulture(OC)=\{v,bl,p,a,bh,k\}$
\par\end{center}

\indent Annotation:
\begin{itemize}
\item $Values(v)$
\item $Beliefs(bl)$
\item $Policies(p)$
\item $Attitudes(a)$
\item $Behaviors(bh)$
\item $Knowledge(k)$
\end{itemize}
Different culture in organization will affect unsustainable system,
for instance in Beasiswa Unggulan implemented access control in its
system. Any fitur in Beasiswa Unggulan system that only can be accessed
by head of office, while in the fact that the head of office often
give the right access to his subordinates. In this case, we see that

\begin{center}
$AccessControl(t_{real})<>AccessControl(t_{fact})$
\par\end{center}

$AccessControl(t_{real})$ is a circumstances where the system is
run in accordance with applicable rules.

$AccessControl(t_{fact})$ is a circumstances where the system is
run in accordance with with the reality of the matter.

\subsection*{Contoh penulisan atau penggunaan persamaan atau rumus matematis:}

\begin{equation}
w_{t,d}=tf_{t,d}\cdot log\dfrac{|\,D\,|}{|\left\{ d^{'}\epsilon\,D\,|\,\,t\epsilon d^{'}\right\} |}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
p(\theta|\alpha)=\dfrac{\Gamma{\textstyle {\displaystyle (\sum^{k}_{i=1}\alpha_{i})}}}{\prod^{k}_{i=1}\Gamma(\alpha_{i})}\theta^{\alpha_{1}-1}_{1}\ldots\theta^{\alpha_{k}-1}_{k},
\end{equation}


\subsection*{Contoh penulisan algoritma:}

\begin{algorithm}[h]
\caption{\label{alg:Algoritma-Markov-Chain}Algoritma {\small\textit{Markov
Chain }}}

\begin{enumerate}
\item {\small\textsf{Randomly initialize the first sampel $(x_{1},...,x_{n})$}}{\small\par}
\item {\small\textsf{For each cycle $t$ until convergence}}

\begin{enumerate}
\item {\small\textsf{sampel $x^{t}_{1}$ form $P(x_{1}|x^{t-1}_{2},\ldots,x^{t-1}_{n})$}}{\small\par}
\item {\small\textsf{sample $x^{t}_{2}$ form $P(x_{1}|x^{t-1}_{1},x^{t-1}_{3},\ldots,x^{t-1}_{n})$}}{\small\par}
\item {\small\textsf{continue until you sample $x^{t}_{n}$ from $P(x_{1}|x^{t-1}_{1},\ldots,x^{t-1}_{n-1})$}}{\small\par}
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
\end{algorithm}
